business_summary: Premium running apparel brand with a heritage, New England aesthetic, targeting affluent, serious recreational marathoners aged 30-55.
stated_claims: Running apparel with a heritage, New England feel
Our customer is a serious recreational marathoner, higher income, 30-55

relevant_tags.why: Core category: brand sells performance running apparel.
Core category: brand sells clothing (singlets, jackets).
Adjacent interest: brand features a heritage, New England aesthetic.
Adjacent demographic: target age group is 30-55.
Weak adjacent: runners buying running apparel also purchase running shoes.
Weak adjacent: serious recreational marathoners are highly likely to participate in fitness and conditioning classes.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Pricing of singlets from $58 and jackets at $200+ directly clashes with value-conscious preferences.
High price points ($200+ jackets) and higher-income targeting position this as a luxury/premium athletic brand.

note_signals.why: Fitness-engaged shoppers match the profile of serious recreational marathoners.
Users actively spending on self-care and fitness align with high-income recreational athletes.
Older affluent demographic matches the 30-55 age range and high-income requirements.
Highest-AOV apparel publisher with a conservative brand sensibility fits the premium heritage aesthetic perfectly.
Activewear and shoe focus targets urban professionals who overlap with the marathoner demographic.

gate_reason: The product category, pricing, target demographic, and brand aesthetic are clearly defined, making it highly actionable for publisher matching.
